policy: Repository-owned product workflows come from the checked-out owning repository. Cross-repository or machine skills have exactly one versioned source; global installs are symlinks or generated installs from that source, never independently edited copies. Data Analyze is migration evidence, not a source for newly launched sessions. No active Worker is migrated in place.

squad-dispatcher.note: Maintained Dispatcher skill; global installs must link the installed snapshot of this source.

studio-issue-worker.note: Maintained Studio Worker skill; global installs must link the installed snapshot of this source.

cmux-sessions.note: Versioned Agent Loop tool skill (PR #13 merged); global installs must link the installed snapshot of this source.

agent-loop-worker.note: Generic Worker role skill for Squad/Importer/Interceptor assignments.

squad-pr-reviewer-core.note: Reviewer skill embedded in the Go reviewer bundle (reviewer/bundle.go).

squad-env-recovery.note: No versioned source in this repository yet. Live global copy at ~/.claude/skills/squad-env-recovery (-> ~/.codex/skills/squad-env-recovery) has unknown source revision; do not treat it as canonical until a versioned source lands.

transfer-docker-image.note: No versioned source in this repository yet. Live global copy is an independently maintained install with unknown source revision.

convoai-call-studio-import.note: Canonical source is the ConvoAI Studio Importer repository (skills/convoai-call-studio-import/SKILL.md); this repository only routes to it via workspace/agent-loop/projects/importer/profile.json. The global copy trails that source.

studio-sls-logs.note: Canonical source is the Studio repository (.agents/skills/studio-sls-logs); Voice Agent Studio PR #983 merged. This repository only routes to it, never copies it.

studio-staging-sls-logs.note: Time-bounded compatibility alias only for sessions launched before migration; new references must use studio-sls-logs.
